description: JUnit 5 extension for unit testing Maven 3 plugins: injects a configured mojo, a mocked MavenProject and MavenSession into the test.
rules: Annotate the test class with @MojoTest and receive the mojo as a test method parameter annotated with @InjectMojo(goal = ..., pom = ...).
AbstractMojoTestCase and MojoRule are deprecated JUnit 3 and 4 APIs; do not use them in new tests.
@InjectMojo applies only the plugin's <configuration> from the POM; the injected MavenProject is a Mockito spy, so stub any other project state the mojo reads.
Set single parameters with @MojoParameter(name = ..., value = ...) and the project directory with @Basedir.
